meta.name: codex-skill
meta.description: Leverage OpenAI Codex/GPT models for autonomous code implementation. Triggers: "codex", "use gpt", "gpt-5", "let openai", "full-auto", "用codex", "让gpt实现". Use this skill whenever the user wants to delegate coding tasks to OpenAI models, run code reviews via codex, or execute tasks in a sandboxed environment.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AI自动编写和审查代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望用AI自动完成编码任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate code writing and review with AI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to delegate coding tasks to AI

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以调用 OpenAI Codex/GPT 模型来自动完成编程任务，包括代码实现、代码审查、文件读写、运行测试等，并输出结构化结果。
howto.when: 当用户说出“codex”、“use gpt”、“让gpt实现”等触发词，或要求委托编程任务、运行代码审查时触发。

say.text: 用 codex 实现用户登录功能。
让 gpt 审查我未提交的代码变更。
用 codex 分析项目代码行数。
say.note: Claude 会以只读模式执行分析。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can invoke OpenAI Codex/GPT models to autonomously complete coding tasks, including code implementation, code review, file read/write, running tests, etc., and output structured results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says trigger words like "codex", "use gpt", "让gpt实现", or requests to delegate coding tasks or run code reviews.

say_en.text: Use codex to implement user login feature.
say_en.note: Claude will invoke Codex to write code in the workspace.

say_en.text: Let gpt review my uncommitted changes.
say_en.note: Claude will run codex exec review --uncommitted.

say_en.text: Use codex to analyze project lines of code.
say_en.note: Claude will execute analysis in read-only mode.
